description: Participant a creates an ACCDB with table T (ID LONG primary key, M MEMO), closes and reopens it shared, signals, then runs INSERT INTO T SELECT for 2048 rows with 2000-character memos. Participant b, 30 ms after a's signal, suspends a; while a is suspended it observes the database and lock files, tries a DAO shared read-only open of the database and reads COUNT(*), then resumes a. a reports its RecordsAffected and the final count. Asks what another process sees of a database and its lock file while a writer is frozen inside a statement.
retentionNote: Designed r-ops probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
